# Admin + User Accounts, Login Control, Auto "Generated by"

## Ki hobe

1. **Duita role thakbe: Admin ar User.**
   - **Admin** — shob kichu korte pare, ar **Users page** theke onno account create/edit/deactivate/delete korte pare.
   - **User** — normal kaj korte pare (entry, report dekha/print), kintu Users page dekhte ba account manage korte parbe na.
2. **Account create** — Name, Position, Email, Password, Role (Admin/User).
   - Prothom bar (kono account nei): login screen-e "Create Admin Account" form — prothom account-ti **Admin**.
   - Erpor notun Admin/User add hobe app-er bhitor **Users** page theke.
3. **Login restricted** — email/password list-er sathe na milale: "Access denied. Invalid email or password." Inactive account hole: "Your account is inactive."
4. **Users page (shudhu Admin)** — table-e prottek account: Name, Position, Email, Role (Admin/User), **Status (Active/Inactive)**, **Online / Last active**, Created date. Action:
   - **Add** (Name, Position, Email, Password, Role)
   - **Edit** (name/position/email/password/role)
   - **Deactivate / Activate** toggle — inactive korle ar login korte parbe na, record thakbe
   - **Delete** — purai muche jabe. Nijer account delete/deactivate kora jabe na; shesh (ek matro) Admin-o delete/downgrade kora jabe na.
5. **Report-e name/position automatic** — login kora account-er Name + Position + Email report header ("Generated by", "Position") ar footer-e automatic boshbe; hard-coded "Md. Rakib Hasan / QC" remove. Report-e role label show hobe na — shudhu Name + Position.
6. **Sidebar user chip**-e `Name · Position` (role label chhara).
7. Deactivate/delete hole oi browser-er active session-o auto logout hoye jabe; purono/invalid session hole app khulei login screen.

## Technical details (`public/app/index.html`)

- State-e notun array: `users: [{id, name, position, email, passHash, role:"Admin"|"User", active:true, createdAt, lastLoginAt, lastSeenAt}]` (`migrateState`-e default `[]`). Password shudhu `hashString()` hash hishebe store.
- Login screen duita mode: `#signInBox` (email+password) ar `#createAdminBox`; `state.users.length === 0` hole create form default (role force `Admin`).
- `loginForm.onsubmit`: email lowercase + `hashString(pass)` compare; mismatch/inactive hole error, state change na. Match hole `state.user = {id, name, position, email, role, loggedIn:true}`, `lastLoginAt`/`lastSeenAt` update, audit log.
- **Online/last active**: `lastSeenAt` login-e ar prottek navigate/save-e update (~60s throttle). Users page-e 2 min-er bhitore hole green "Online", noile "Last active: <time>", kokhono login na korle "Never".
- Notun page `users` + sidebar nav button — `state.user.role === "Admin"` na hole nav hidden ar `show('users')` block.
- Add/Edit modal-e duplicate email block, self-delete/self-deactivate block, last-admin protection. Shob action audit log-e.
- `show()`/startup guard: current `state.user.id` `state.users`-e ache kina ar `active` kina verify — na hole auto logout.
- `generatedBy()` `state.user` theke `{name, position, email}` return korbe; `printMeta()`/`reportFooter()` `u.position` use korbe.
- `syncHeader()` chip-e Name · Position. Login markup theke purono `#loginRoleSelect` remove (role ekhon account record theke ashe).
- Company register form-e Name + Position field add (oi flow prothom Admin toiri kore).

## Note

Data browser-er localStorage-e thake (app-er bortoman design), tai delete/deactivate oi browser-er data-tei prozojjo. Shob device-e ek account ar server-side password verify chaile bolun — Lovable Cloud diye setup kore dibo.
